identity.name: GitHub-based Command and Control with Rare URL Containment
identity.summary: An attacker downloads a payload from a rare GitHub URL, executes it, and establishes C2 communication. Cortex detects the rare URL and contained process execution.

biocs.name: Contained Process Execution with Rare GitHub URL
biocs.description: Process execution initiated from a contained environment with a rare GitHub URL
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = '/bin/bash'
| filter action_file_path = '/tmp/evil/payload.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = '/bin/bash'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
